title: Export items by EAN (import-ready XML file)
description: Exports the items of the PRODUCTS table matching the EANs received in the job execution input (eansCsv, comma-separated), as an import-ready XML file exposed in the job output. Designed to be triggered by another job through data-job-execution-create with wait=true. Not meant to be shared: it always runs on the account that owns the items.

tasks.name: file-transformation-xslt
tasks.description: Build the Items-Request document filtered on the requested EANs (the XSLT runs on a dummy source and reads the eans parameter)

tasks.name: table-export-items
tasks.description: Export the items matching the request
